name: Barbell Kneeling Jump Squat
steps: Kneel upright on a forgiving surface with a light barbell held snugly across your upper back and your toes tucked or flat behind you.
Brace your core and sit your hips back toward your heels to load the hinge.
Drive your hips explosively forward and upward to spring off your shins, whipping both feet cleanly beneath you to land in a squat.
Stabilize your squat, stand if desired, and step carefully back down to kneeling one knee at a time.
tips: Pull the bar tightly against your upper back so it stays secure during the explosive hop.
Master unweighted kneeling jumps first and use only a light barbell.
